title: The Night Garden

panels.desc: The second garden at night under a deep blue sky with a big smiling crescent moon. A brown monkey sits in a tree holding a glowing golden seed tightly, pouting. Bun holds up a white milk carton toward the monkey; Hedgie points at the moon; Pip glows like a little lamp beside them. Hidden in the picture: the moon, the monkey, the milk carton. In the foreground, a big clay flower pot with only the tip of Grumble's striped nightcap sticking out of the top; a warm lantern glow shines from inside the pot and lights the ground around it.

A dark pond in the night garden lit by nine twinkling stars in the sky. A brown otter floats on its back tangled in a butterfly net, holding a glowing seed on its tummy. Pip, who tried to help by touching its nose like the friends do, has tumbled head-first into the same net and is stuck upside down with its feet in the air. Hedgie pulls the net handle; Bun giggles. Behind them the new M letter tree with milk-, moon- and monkey-shaped fruits. Hidden in the picture: the net, the otter, nine stars in the sky. Grumble does NOT appear.

The pond edge at night. A friendly purple octopus rises from the water with a glowing seed on its head and squirts a big spray of black ink: Hedgie's nose is covered with a round ink blob and he crosses his eyes to look at it; Bun ducks behind a bowl of green olives on the bank; Pip glows. Hidden in the picture: the octopus, the olives, Hedgie's ink-covered nose. Grumble's big clay flower pot has been knocked over by the splash and lies on its side: Grumble's two slippered feet and his lantern stick out of the opening, the lantern glowing a clear warm orange.

The night garden path lit by nine bright stars overhead. Three new letter trees (M with milk, moon and monkey fruits; N with nose, net and nine-balloon fruits; O with otter, octopus and olive fruits) glow softly in the starlight. Bun and Hedgie dance with arms up; Pip glows brightly on top of the M tree. Grumble climbs out of the tipped-over flower pot covered in dirt, nightcap crooked, holding up his lantern which now shines clearly brighter than before and lights his grumpy, surprised face. Hidden in the picture: nine stars, the smiling moon.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation at night: the crescent moon smiles and twinkles, the monkey hugs its glowing seed and then reaches for the milk carton, the baby bird glows softly; the lantern glow inside the big flower pot flickers. Camera still. Calm, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle comic picture-book animation: the purple octopus pops up from the pond and squirts a puff of ink that lands on the hedgehog's nose, the rabbit ducks, the big flower pot wobbles and tips over with two slippered feet poking out; the seed sparkles and with a soft POP a small letter tree sprouts by the pond. Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.
